title: Q-CRIT-LANDED-1: criticality change merged, deployed and scoring (server-owned)
body:
**Owner:** merge lane and executor (server side)
**Trigger:** pull request 305 open; every criticality run adopts open pull requests
**Done check:** cmd:gh api repos/ultrastable/ultrastable/contents/foundation/ignition.py?ref=main --jq .name
**Status:** open

Server-side ownership of the criticality change (SERVER-OWNS-LOOPS-1): the lane merges pull request 305 on green, deploy-workers deploys dashboard 0.3.0 and the criticality workflow posts the first score (k=0.0026 on 2026-11-12) to /api/fleet/criticality. A red check is fixed by the executor from its log. Closes when ignition.py is on main.

size: S

**Closing probe:** cmd:gh api repos/ultrastable/ultrastable/contents/foundation/ignition.py?ref=main --jq .name
